notes.title: Update Ver2.0 and DLC "Chupa Chupa VR - Boy pack" are now available!
notes.notes:
The updates are as follows. 

It is now possible to choose the BGM in the game. (3 songs by default).
You can now choose a character. (By default, only girls are available.)

 Furthermore, the DLC "Chupa Chupa VR - Boy pack" has been released! 

With the purchase of this DLC, you'll be able to change to a man's boy! (The game remains the same.)
There will also be three additional background music tracks.

notes.title: Update to version 1.3
notes.notes:
The updates are as follows

The timing of the end of tongue clarification was changed (clarification took longer than before)
Fixed the position of the hand when using Oculus(Rift&Quest).
When using Oculus(Rift&Quest) and enabling up and down movement, the height can be changed by either hand.

notes.title: Update to version 1.2
notes.notes:
Update to version 1.2

Updated to version 1.2! 
The updates are as follows

・The "Vertical movement" and "Rotation" functions have been implemented.
・Turning on/off the "up/down movement" and "Rotation" function in the nurse's office
・Change the way to control VIVE (grip or left center button for warp, right center button for "Vertical movement" + "Rotation")

The "Vertical movement" and "Rotation" functions are off by default and must be enabled in the menu in the infirmary to use them.

notes.title: Update version 1.1
notes.notes:
Updated to version 1.1! 
The updates are as follows.

- Fixed a bug that made some objects ungraspable
- Fixed a bug that prevented ranking from being displayed
-Specifications changed to not sound a heartbeat after game over


The next version 1.2 update will include the following contents.
(*This schedule is subject to change.)

-Implementation of "crouching" and "rotating" functions
-Switching the "squat" and "rotation" functions on and off in the nurse's office
